title: MACP 2.0 Registry Entry
description: One registered agent. The roster resource (macp://project/{project}/roster) is a JSON array of live entries; macp://self returns the caller's own entry including grants held.

role.description: Free-form role label supplied via macp_register (e.g. 'worker', 'reviewer', 'orchestrator').

capabilities.description: Free-form capability labels supplied via macp_register — what peers may ask this agent for.

roots.description: Workspace roots declared via MCP roots/list, as scope evidence (spec §5.1). Informative; the resolved 'project' field is authoritative.

conformance.description: Conformance level of this agent's harness/binding, if declared. L1+ recipients receive realtime delivery; L0 recipients are poll-only.

endpoint.description: Optional L3 drive endpoint: an MCP server URL served by this agent's harness (spec §12 L3). Access is grant-gated.

live.description: Connection open and responsive (spec §5.2). Stale entries are excluded from default roster reads.

grants.description: Grants HELD BY this agent (present only on macp://self; omitted from roster reads of other agents).
